decisions.title: Sign or reject the endless hazard product contract
decisions.ask: Sign or reject the endless hazard contract (obstacles, enemies and items in phases)?
decisions.recommendation: Read the draft and sign it if you still want difficulty to come from hazards: it is the only lever past level 268 that keeps zoom and board size frozen.
decisions.context: The draft contract for obstacles, enemies and items is unsigned; five cards are covered by it.

decisions.title: Decide what happens past level 198 so levels keep getting harder
decisions.ask: After level 268, is the lever for endless difficulty hazards (the same decision as signing MAZER-HAZ-002) or a bigger board?
decisions.recommendation: Hazards: you ruled out zoom and board size, and without a new lever the ladder plateaus at 268.
decisions.context: The ladder ends at level 268; the lever after that is a product call.

decisions.title: Decide the six design-board picks: font, quit confirm, start style, icons, backdrop, HUD
decisions.ask: Do you want the build agent to record the six design picks on its own judgement, or do you want to choose them yourself?
decisions.recommendation: Say "go" so the build agent records each pick with its reason (quit confirm is already shipped as MAZER-FLOW-005); that unblocks MAZER-UI-010, UI-015, VIS-011 and VIS-012.
decisions.context: Six design picks are unrecorded (display font, quit confirm, START style, icon construction, backdrop, play HUD) and four graphics cards wait on them.

decisions.title: Decide whether the game has sound
decisions.ask: Should Mazer have sound at all, and should it default to on or off?
decisions.recommendation: Allow small synthesized effects behind a Settings toggle, default off.
decisions.context: There is no audio anywhere in the game and no sound setting.

decisions.title: Sign the shop and random item economy contract
decisions.ask: Sign or reject the shop and random-item economy draft contract?
decisions.recommendation: Defer signing until the hazard contract is settled; no Phase 1 work depends on it.
decisions.context: The draft contract for coins, shop and random items is unsigned; most not-started economy cards depend on it.

decisions.title: Decide: resume the same maze after quit or reload
decisions.ask: When a player quits or reloads mid-level, should the same maze resume or should the next Start roll a new maze?
decisions.recommendation: Resume the same maze so quitting is not a free re-roll (needs seed plumbing).
decisions.context: Quitting or reloading today discards the attempt, so the next Start is a free re-roll.

decisions.title: Decide when input unlocks during the level intro
decisions.ask: When should input unlock after reaching the goal: as now (about 2.5 s), at 75 percent of the reveal, or when the beams land plus a margin?
decisions.recommendation: Keep the current unlock: you twice said build and deconstruct felt too fast.
decisions.context: After a goal input is locked about 2.5 s; an earlier unlock touches the timer, pacing and AI scoring.

decisions.title: Add an in-game reduced-motion setting and finish the gating: open for review, held
decisions.ask: Under reduced motion, should the title and level-number rainbow stop shifting colour, or keep shifting colour and only stop moving?
decisions.recommendation: Keep the colours shifting and stop only the movement; PR #425 is then changed to match and merged.
decisions.context: PR #425 is green but held: under reduced motion it also freezes the title, START and level-number rainbow to one hue.

decisions.title: Settle the install gate policy and prove the offline shell
decisions.ask: Should the install gate stay mandatory in install modes where it blocks boot, given access is meant to be enforced by entitlement?
decisions.recommendation: Keep the gate as shipped until entitlements exist (MAZER-ECON-003), then revisit.
decisions.context: The install gate blocks boot in some install modes without a skip, which clashes with enforcing access by entitlement.

verify.step: Install Mazer on the phone, open it once online, turn on airplane mode, force-close the app and open it again.
verify.expected: The app shell opens and shows the offline-capable start screen.

decisions.title: Unify the backdrop across boot, install gate and sign-in
decisions.ask: Approve one near-black canvas colour across boot, install gate and sign-in, with a calmer gate starfield, the app icon on the install screen and a dot-matrix wordmark on boot?
decisions.recommendation: Approve it; portal alignment is tracked as a separate card in another repo.
decisions.context: Three visual dialects exist (game, install and sign-in pages, account portal); this is the backdrop pick in MAZER-UI-020.

decisions.title: Add shared-seed daily and weekly challenges
decisions.ask: Do you want shared-seed daily and weekly challenges, and at what cadence?
decisions.recommendation: Park until the economy and hazard contracts are settled.
decisions.context: The server seed and leaderboard parts would need a provider change.

decisions.title: Decide a minimum tile size for very large boards
decisions.ask: Should the game set a minimum tile size for very large boards, or explicitly defer zoom?
decisions.recommendation: Defer explicitly and record it, since board size and zoom are frozen.
decisions.context: On a 390 phone at level 99 the tile is about 6.5 px, so the player and goal are tiny.

decisions.title: Define a handcrafted asset authoring and import workflow
decisions.ask: Do you want a handcrafted-asset import workflow, and in which file format?
decisions.recommendation: Park it as deferred; no open card depends on it.
decisions.context: Not started; needs an owner decision on the asset format.

decisions.title: Route auth, sync, username and boot errors into the message toast
decisions.ask: Which of auth, sync, username and boot errors should appear in the message toast?
decisions.recommendation: Show auth, username and boot errors; keep remote sync silent.
decisions.context: Remote sync is deliberately silent today, so showing sync failures changes that stance.

checks.title: Verify deployed Mazer changes on a real phone and installed app
checks.ask: Run the phone checks below on the real phone and the installed app and tell me what failed.
checks.recommendation: Do the whole list in one sitting on the current production build; each failure becomes a follow-up card.
checks.context: Everything shipped since 2026-11-06 was checked on bundles, tests and headless frames only.

verify.step: Tap the pause gear in play with your thumb (MAZER-UI-014).
verify.expected: Pause opens on the first tap.

verify.step: Rotate the phone while a run is live (MAZER-FLOW-008).
verify.expected: The game pauses and Pause says "Rotate back to keep playing" until you rotate back.

verify.step: Signed in, turn on airplane mode, finish a level, then turn it off (MAZER-FLOW-009).
verify.expected: One "saved offline" notice during the outage, then one "synced" notice after.

verify.step: Open Settings and look for the Haptics row, then bump a wall (MAZER-CTRL-001, MAZER-MOTION-003).
verify.expected: A Haptics row exists (on by default); a wall bump nudges the player 2 px and buzzes where the phone supports vibration (iOS does not).

verify.step: Trigger any player message, for example the offline notice above (MAZER-UI-018).
verify.expected: A readable toast appears and no message promises guest play.

verify.step: Open Mazer in a normal browser tab, not installed (MAZER-FLOW-010).
verify.expected: The install gate shows a one-line value statement and a mini-maze mark; Copy link shows "Link copied".

verify.step: Leave the menu demo running for a few mazes (MAZER-FLOW-007).
verify.expected: The menu AI climbs one level per completed maze.

verify.step: Walk out along the trail and back around corners (MAZER-VIS-020).
verify.expected: The trail follows every corner with no cut or snap when stepping back.

verify.step: Clear a level (MAZER-VIS-019, MAZER-FLOW-004).
verify.expected: Only the rainbow level number shows: no "Level N" caption and no rank letter.

verify.step: Open ?previewLevel=60, 100 and 190 and play each (MAZER-PROG-015).
verify.expected: Tell me whether each feels easier, the same or harder than the one before.

verify.step: In the installed app, watch the orbit, deconstruct, goal star, trail and locator, and open the Settings sheets.
verify.expected: All render cleanly and match the last captured frames.

checks.title: Skip the Mazer OAuth consent screen (Continue to Mazer?): merged, not deployed
checks.ask: Open Mazer from the home screen, sign in, and tell me whether a "Continue to Mazer?" screen appears.
checks.recommendation: Do it once with your real account; if the consent screen still appears, report it and keep the card in review.
checks.context: FawxzzyWeb PR #118 is merged and aliased live (2026-11-11); no real-device sign-in has been checked.

verify.step: Open Mazer from the home screen, sign out if needed, and sign in.
verify.expected: You land back in Mazer with NO "Continue to Mazer?" screen.

checks.title: Branded Mazer auth emails
checks.ask: Click the link in a Mazer account-recovery email and check the sign-up and change-of-address emails.
checks.recommendation: Use the throwaway QA account; one pass covers all three emails.
checks.context: A Mazer-themed recovery email was delivered, but the link click and the sign-up and change-of-address emails are unverified for Mazer.

verify.step: Request account recovery for the QA account and click the link in the Mazer-themed email.
verify.expected: The link opens the reset flow and works.

verify.step: Create a new throwaway account and open the sign-up email.
verify.expected: A Mazer-themed email arrives and its link works.

verify.step: Change the email address on the QA account and open the change-of-address email.
verify.expected: A Mazer-themed email arrives and its link works.

checks.title: Reduce canvas redraw cost and soften the throttle floor
checks.ask: Capture a frame-rate trace on your phone while the menu is idle and while playing a large board.
checks.recommendation: Build the backdrop bake first so one trace shows the fix; the trace is the proof the card requires.
checks.context: Replaying thousands of drawing commands costs 2.6-4.9 ms per frame; the fix needs a real-device frame trace to prove it.

verify.step: Record a performance trace on the phone (remote Safari or Chrome inspector) on the idle menu and in play on a large board.
verify.expected: Average frame time stays below the 19 ms point where the game drops ambient motion to 4 fps; the trace is attached to the card.

checks.title: Close the mobile shell device harness with real-device proof
checks.ask: Run the mobile-shell device harness on your phone and tell me the device model and the result.
checks.recommendation: Do it in the same sitting as the MAZER-QA-001 phone pass.
checks.context: The mobile-shell device harness exists but has never been run on a real phone.

verify.step: Run the mobile-shell device harness on the phone (the card does not name the command; ask the build agent for the run steps first).
verify.expected: The harness passes, the device model is recorded and any gap becomes a card.

checks.title: Trail colour reported static on the owner phone: not reproduced, needs device data
checks.ask: What are Reduce Motion (iOS Accessibility) and Trail Shine (Mazer Settings) set to on your phone, and does the trail still look static?
checks.recommendation: If Reduce Motion is on or Trail Shine is off, that explains it: set Reduce Motion off and Trail Shine on and look again; if it still looks static, send the phone model.
checks.context: Headless runs show the trail colour changing every 250 ms; the phone still looks static, so the likely cause is a setting.

verify.step: Note iOS Settings > Accessibility > Motion > Reduce Motion (on or off) and Mazer Settings > Trail Shine (on or off).
verify.expected: Both settings are written down.

verify.step: With Reduce Motion off and Trail Shine on, walk a level and watch the trail.
verify.expected: The trail colour visibly shifts over time; if it stays static, report both settings and the phone model.
